reviews.comment: I'm not sure why these ratings are so low because I really enjoyed Professor Rahman's class. I'm not very good at math but she had no problem answering my questions after class. Just do all her assignments, print them out, make notes on them and that should suffice for the open-note exams. She is delightful when you get to know her!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Rahman is such a sweet and compassionate person. If you take her, make sure you participate. She notices those who answer/ask questions. Homework is a huge part of your grade so dont forget to submit or have a good reason

This class was pretty good. Make sure you print out the slides, and write down everything she does. Since class is coding based, do it with her. Definitely find someone to do hw with you, and give yourself time to work thorough all the problems. Also, try to understand the ins-&-outs of the code so that you can know why it's being used.

Professor Rahman is really cares about her students and wants them to get an A. Goes fast in lectures and is bit unorganized at times, but just ask her to slow down or reexplain something and she gladly will. The homeworks were graded very generously and the tests are easy and open note. Go to TA office hours for HW. With a little effort- easy A.

I don't understand the bad reviews as this was one of the most caring profs I have had! As long as you go to lecture, look over the power points, and do your homework, that is already a guarantee to pass the class. She is available in office hours and is more than willing to help. She also posted the lectures to look back so a plus for that.

Her lectures slides are very helpful but she moves quickly and writes really fast so its a little hard to keep up. Just make sure to go back and read through them to help with the HW. I really enjoyed the quotes at the beginning of every lecture! Very inspirational. Put in some effort and you can easily get an A or B.

I am writing this after seeing how unfair other reviewers have been. This isn't a hard class by any means and the prof isn't bad at all like other reviews say. Sure, lecture can be a little unorganized sometimes, but that can be easily solved by simply going back and making sense of things. People just like to complain because they put no effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: hmm. this is a tough one. just kidding, she sucks. did not have a fun time with this class, she was really unorganized and it didn't even seem like she understood the material herself. always veered off the syllabus and nothing was clear.

Dr. Rahman was horrible-- inaccessible and inconsistent to her schedule/syllabus. Our lectures were way behind, the midterm was a complete toss-up on what would be on it. The syllabus said the final would be cumulative... 4 days before the final, after countless emails, she disclosed it would be everything after the midterm. Take the other prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She has good knowledge of the course content but has no clue how to teach the class. Her lectures are confusing and the content is all over the place. I would just take the other prof, there is probably more structure to that class.

She's a very nice person and tries to make it easy to succeed in her class. The only thing that bothered me was that the class seemed a bit disorganized and sometimes I had no idea what was going on, I was just copying the notes because she goes very fast. Overall a good class, though.
She said 6 was an odd number. Twice. On our midterm.

I hated this class so much. Maybe a different prof would have made it better, but this prof is arguably the worst prof I've had. Just don't take her class. Or this class in general if you can avoid it.

Be ready to teach yourself this class. Absolutely terrible prof and class. She rushes through lecture. Doesn't attend her own office hours sometimes. Assigns homework over material we haven't covered in class. Never updated the syllabus after the snow week. Is extremely behind on what she is supposed to be teaching. Doesn't answer emails.

Homework 1-5 were supposed to be on the midterm and 6-10 on the final. My midterm we had barely done 3. There are two weeks left of the semester and we just did homework 7. She has been consistently behind the entire semester. She doesn't answer emails. Spells everything wrong, to the point even some of her own code won't work. Class is all code.

Dr. Rahman's class was by far my favorite class in college. She was so passionate about teaching, and truly gives you every tool to succeed. You can easily make an A if you attend class, actually understand the homework, and go to office hours and reviews. She gives you a good ML bases to go from there. I loved her and the class. Very recommended!!

She is a cold prof that doesn't seem to care about her job or students. Lack of enthusiasm. Lots of typos and teaching mistakes. Had to be corrected by students multiple times. Would give homework on topics not taught yet. In summary, I would not recommend taking her class. I would go as far to say I would actively recommend NOT taking her class.

Terrible. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASSES. She doesn't even care enough to run her papers through spell check. Everything is spelled wrong all the time to the point it's hard to tell what she is trying to write sometimes. Her accent is easily understood aside from the fact that she can't be bothered to learn to pronounce necessary words for the class.

There are weekly quizzes taken in class that aren't too bad if you pay attention. Homework is easy. Tests are somewhat confusing. She was hard to reach at times nearing the end of the semester. If you have a basic understanding of statistics and some common knowledge you should be good to get an A.

decent enough during first half of the semester but when we went online after spring break, unreliable and unhelpful. Added an uneccesary project and kept saying she would give us quizzes which she didn't give until the day before the final. Very unorganized, not understanding, and very hard to understand. Words questions very badly. did not enjoy
She assigned us 2 quizzes after the last day of classes and the night before our final. She was so disorganized and hard to reach. She added a project to our syllabus
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Rahman is a sweet and understanding professor. However, she is incredibly unorganized. Our syllabus was changed multiple times throughout the semester. She gave us a project and two quizzes during the exam week and was not very clear about anything class expectations and everything was subjective to change. Lecture was also confusing.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Very clear syllabus, allows the use of a sheet of notes on the test. Often absent from the classroom and will have a sub. Decent lecturer. She mentioned bonus points for eval, but didn't follow through resulting in missing the A just barely.

She is a very nice lady and gives you everything you need to pass and even make an A. She truly tries to get to know her students and even knew my name by the end of the semester. Her homework is easy and worth more than a test grade and she allows a full page front and back cheat sheet for exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: A great teacher overall. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I would suggest showing up to class if you want a good grade. The homework can be tough at times, but she allows multiple attempts, so I was able to get 100 on most of them. The quizzes are open notes, and she uploads a practice exam before every exam. She answers all questions too.
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She's a good prof. The material isn't that hard. 2 midterms, final, about 4-5 quizzes and A LOT of hw. Grades were 92,78,and 69 on final and 98 on hw and 95 on quizzes and I got a B. She said she will give 3 bonus points to OVERALL GRADE for course evalution, but she didn't. I would have gotten an A if she did. Not that hard, cheat sheet for exams.
